title: Finding Your Bias
hook: Clear Read the Room, pass the Knowledge Check and save your Check-In to unlock Section 2.

game.title: Read the Room 🏠
game.tagline: You’ve learned the pieces. Now I’m taking the labels away. Read the room.
game.doneBadge: Read the Room: all 10 levels cleared
game.doneLine: You found the doors, read the room, built both stories, defined invalidation, chose to wait when nothing was clean, and finished a full top-down read without jumping to an entry.

questionBank.question: Which one is a working thesis?
options: NQ is definitely hitting the high today
Bullish continuation is supported unless the 1H low fails
questionBank.why: Conditional, structural, and it says what would change it.

questionBank.question: On this 4H chart, what are the doors?
options: The highest and lowest candles on the screen
The external high and low defining the current room

questionBank.question: The 4H room is bullish and the 1H is making lower lows. What’s the most reasonable read?
options: A potential internal correction inside the room
One of the timeframes is wrong
questionBank.why: The furniture can move while the doors hold.

questionBank.question: Price closed through the 4H external high and formed a new swing high. What do you do?
options: Update the map to the new structure

questionBank.question: Which 1H swing usually matters most to the current leg?
options: The swing the current leg started from
The oldest swing on the chart

questionBank.question: A bullish 1H MSS forms inside a bullish 4H room. What is it?
options: Structural information that supports the thesis
questionBank.why: MSS changes the conversation. Dayli ICC decides entries.

questionBank.question: Bullish thesis. Which is a reasonable potential objective?
options: A tiny 1H high just above price
questionBank.why: External, aligned with the thesis, and potential, never guaranteed.

questionBank.question: Same bullish thesis. Price A is low in the room, price B sits right under the external high. Same room to the objective?
questionBank.why: Direction is the same. Room to the objective isn’t.

questionBank.question: Which is a good alternate scenario?
options: IF the 1H low breaks, THEN reassess toward the 4H external low

questionBank.question: What invalidates a bullish thesis built on a 1H shift?
options: A 1H close back below the relevant 1H low
questionBank.why: A structural event, not a feeling or a trade result.

questionBank.question: “I’m bullish until my trade loses.” What’s wrong?
options: Trade outcome alone doesn’t define structural invalidation
questionBank.why: Thesis invalidation changes the analysis. A stop exits a position.

questionBank.question: Your bullish thesis depended on a 1H low. Price closes below it. Your thesis is…
questionBank.why: New information received. Update the read.

questionBank.question: The 4H overlaps with no clean progression, and the 1H chops both ways. Bias?
questionBank.why: No clean directional thesis is a valid conclusion.

questionBank.question: You finished a full 4H → 1H thesis. What now?
options: Continue the top-down process and wait for execution criteria later

questionBank.question: Why start a read on the 4H?
options: It shows the larger environment: the doors and where price sits
questionBank.why: Read the room before the furniture.

questionBank.question: What does the 1H add to a 4H read?
options: How price is moving inside the 4H room
questionBank.why: The 1H builds the map inside the room.
